methods.name: startSession
methods.description:
Starts a real-time chat session for a conversation

Creates a WebSocket session and returns a SessionStream for sending
and receiving messages in real-time.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves an active session by conversation ID

methods.name: endSession
methods.description:
Ends an active session for a conversation

Sends a session end event and releases the socket for the conversation.
If no active session exists for the given conversation, this is a no-op.

methods.description: Gets entity records by entity ID

methods.name: getRecordById
methods.description: Gets a single entity record by entity ID and record ID

methods.name: insertRecordById
methods.description:
Inserts a single record into an entity by entity ID

Note: Data Fabric supports trigger events only on individual inserts, not on inserting multiple records.
Use this method if you need trigger events to fire for the inserted record.

methods.name: insertRecordsById
methods.description:
Inserts one or more records into an entity by entity ID

Note: Records inserted using insertRecordsById will not trigger Data Fabric trigger events. Use {@link insertRecordById} if you need
trigger events to fire for each inserted record.

methods.name: updateRecordsById
methods.description: Updates data in an entity by entity ID

methods.name: deleteRecordsById
methods.description: Deletes data from an entity by entity ID

methods.name: downloadAttachment
methods.description: Downloads an attachment stored in a File-type field of an entity record.

methods.name: uploadAttachment
methods.description:
Uploads an attachment to a File-type field of an entity record.

Uses multipart/form-data to upload the file content to the specified field.
